prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Atlanta to replace my air conditioner?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for every Atlanta home, but **The Air Company of Georgia** looks like a strong first call: it reports licensed, insured, NATE-certified technicians and 400+ five-star Google reviews, including customer feedback about system replacements. [The Air Company](https://www.theaircompanyga.com/)

I’d also get quotes from **PV Heating, Cooling & Plumbing** and **Reliable Heating & Air** before deciding. PV advertises free replacement estimates and strong installation guarantees; Reliable has a long Atlanta-area track record and offers multiple system and warranty options. [PV](https://www.pvhvac.com/air-conditioning/) · [Reliable](https://reliableair.com/cooling/central-ac-installation)

For a fair comparison, ask each company for a written, itemized quote and confirm:
- They’ll assess your home and size the system properly—not just swap equipment based on the old unit.
- The quote includes permits, removal, any ductwork changes, and startup/testing.
- The exact equipment model, efficiency, parts warranty, and labor warranty.
- Their Georgia conditioned-air contractor license and insurance.

I’d compare at least three quotes; financing or a big advertised warranty alone doesn’t tell you whether the installation is a good value.
